name: Detect And Characterize Structural Variations
description: Detects and characterizes structural variations (SVs) in genomic sequencing data using LUMPY for SV detection followed by annotation with COSMIC and/or ClinVar databases.
detailed_description: Detects and characterizes structural variations (SVs) in genomic sequencing data using LUMPY for SV detection followed by annotation with COSMIC and/or ClinVar databases.
when_to_use: When you need detect and characterize structural variations analysis

parameters.bam_file_path: [Required] Path to the aligned sequencing data in BAM format (str)
parameters.reference_genome_path: [Required] Path to the reference genome in FASTA format (str)
parameters.output_dir: [Required] Directory where results will be saved (str)
parameters.cosmic_db_path: [Optional] Path to the COSMIC database for cancer annotation
parameters.clinvar_db_path: [Optional] Path to the ClinVar database for clinical annotation
